A1_S2_D2: ^Narrator: Before you is a ruin almost twice your height, made of stone and curious symbols.
^Amelia: Ugh, this thing… We’ll need to find a way around it.
A1_S2_D2_cont: ^Amelia: You sure? Those blocks need at least a few people to move them.
^Tutorial: To unlock the exit, you must push down on all the buttons in the ruins.
^Tutorial: You can do this by moving the blocks.
^Tutorial: To push a block, simply walk into them.
^Tutorial: To reset the puzzle, simply walk out of the entrance, and try again.
